title: Quantifying Membership Inference Risks in Genomic Data Sharing: The Role of Attacker's Auxiliary Information
abstract: arXiv:2611.18909v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Genomic data sharing is essential for biomedical research but introduces significant privacy risks, including membership inference attacks, in which an adversary determines whether a specific individual's data was used in a study. Existing privacy protections are typically applied after a release format has already been chosen, leaving researchers without a principled method to assess dataset-specific risk beforehand. We propose a server-assisted, principal component analysis-based pre-release auditing framework that maps genomic data into a shared low-dimensional space, applies epsilon-local differential privacy via the Laplace mechanism with a formally derived sensitivity for principal component analysis scores, and estimates membership inference attack power at a controlled 5% false-positive rate using a distance-threshold attack. A membership-neutrality diagnostic based on Unbiased Reconstruction Robustness is reported alongside at

translated_title: 量化基因组数据共享中的成员推断风险：攻击者辅助信息的作用
translated_abstract: 基因组数据共享对生物医学研究至关重要，但引入了显著的隐私风险，包括成员推断攻击，即攻击者试图判断某个特定个体的数据是否被用于某项研究。现有的隐私保护措施通常是在发布格式确定之后才被应用，这使得研究人员缺乏一种在发布前评估特定数据集风险的原则性方法。我们提出了一个服务器辅助的、基于主成分分析（PCA）的发布前审计框架，该框架将基因组数据映射到一个共享的低维空间，通过拉普拉斯机制应用epsilon局部差分隐私（其中PCA分数的敏感度经过形式化推导），并使用距离阈值攻击在受控的5%假阳性率下估计成员推断攻击的攻击效力。同时，基于无偏重构鲁棒性的成员中立性诊断也被一并报告……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种服务器辅助的、基于主成分分析的基因组数据发布前隐私审计框架，通过形式化推导敏感度的局部差分隐私拉普拉斯机制和距离阈值成员推断攻击（控制5%假阳性率），实现了在数据发布前对基因组数据共享中成员推断风险的量化评估。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a server-assisted, PCA-based pre-release auditing framework that applies local differential privacy via the Laplace mechanism with formally derived sensitivity and a distance-threshold membership inference attack at a controlled 5% false-positive rate, enabling quantification of membership inference risks in genomic data sharing before release.
